label: Card field fixes (conflicting pregnancy / kids / marriage values)
description: Precedence fixes for cards where copies disagreed on pregnancy, kids or marriage values and no topical curated source covers the card. Each record only overrides the fields named in override_fields, using the cited sources; it adds no categories.

records.title: Oldboy (올드보이)
records.pregnancy_note: Mi-do, the hypnotized woman, is never pregnant. The only pregnancy in the plot is the rumored (phantom) pregnancy of Woo-jin's sister Soo-ah years earlier (Wikipedia).

records.title: Wizards of the Lost Kingdom
records.pregnancy_note: Wikipedia's plot (the princess is hypnotized into becoming Shurka's bride, then freed) and the Mental Block notes mention no pregnancy.
